defects.root_cause: The normalized schema required a non-null actual draw timestamp even when official history only evidenced a local draw date.
defects.required_fix: Represent draw_date_local explicitly, make draw_at nullable, and reject fabricated actual times.

defects.required_fix: Add source-level observed_access, approved_use, evidence references, rate policy and owner/review fields.
